uncited: It solves the problem of visualizing complex scalar fields with multiple material boundaries or analyzing time-evolving volumetric data in a single coherent framework [Multi-Isosurface Extraction](1162-multi-isosurface-extraction.md)[Generalized Marching Cubes](8320-generalized-marching-cubes.md)[STEVE (Space-Time-Enclosing Volume Extraction)](10398-steve-space-time-enclosing-volume-extraction.md).

It differs from single-isosurface methods by managing independent triangle lists for each threshold [Multi-Isosurface Extraction](1162-multi-isosurface-extraction.md), dynamically selecting isovales based on adjacent material types [Generalized Marching Cubes](8320-generalized-marching-cubes.md), or transforming boundary hyper-octants into higher-dimensional simplices to prevent topological ambiguities [STEVE (Space-Time-Enclosing Volume Extraction)](10398-steve-space-time-enclosing-volume-extraction.md).

All children build on [Marching Cubes Lookup and Configuration](2518-marching-cubes-lookup-and-configuration.md), which provides the `edgeTable` and `triangleTable` derived from the 256 possible binary configurations of a voxel's eight corner signs relative to an isovalue [Lookup Table and Ambiguity Handling](10327-lookup-table-and-ambiguity-handling.md).
Beyond this shared foundation, the children diverge into distinct mechanisms: iterative threshold application, material-pair boundary detection, and 4D protomesh construction.
An extension of Marching Cubes into the fourth dimension.

The concept of multi-isosurface extraction was developed to address the need for visualizing multiple thresholds from a single dataset, as described in early implementations using node-based linked lists for triangle storage [Multi-Isosurface Extraction](1162-multi-isosurface-extraction.md).
